---
title: "Ladder diagnostics — telescopic ESS, acceptance, per-tramo evidence variance"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)})
DIG <- "data/e743fd5"
theme_fig <- theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
## INDEXING (parallel_tempering_linear_regression.h, save_Evidence writer):
## row i_beta carries BOTH per-rung and per-tramo quantities. The telescopic
## ESS, the swap acceptance and deltaEvidence_variance use k = i_beta - 1,
## i.e. they describe the TRAMO between rungs i_beta-1 and i_beta (row 0 is
## empty or duplicated); the stretch acceptance is the RUNG's own. Rung 0 is
## beta = 0 (the prior, hottest) and rung 15 is beta = 1 (the posterior).
##
## One line per rung/tramo, from the median over blocks of 1536 iterations.
## The raw series is a sawtooth of period 256 = adapt_beta_every: every
## adaptation event moves the ladder past the window tolerance and the
## telescopic window is discarded, so it never pools more than one cycle
## (it ramps to ~1250 effective samples and restarts at ~20). A block that
## is not a multiple of 256 beats against that sawtooth and fabricates an
## oscillation, hence 1536 = 6 cycles.
BLK <- 1536
scale_tramo <- scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "tramo", breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15),
                                      guide = guide_colourbar(barheight = 3))
scale_rung  <- scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "rung", breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15),
                                      guide = guide_colourbar(barheight = 3))
```

```{r panels, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.6}
d <- fread(file.path(DIG, "ladder_diag.csv"))
d[, blk := (as.integer(iter / BLK) + 0.5) * BLK]
b <- d[, .(ess_up = median(ess_up), ess_dn = median(ess_dn),
           acc_within = median(acc_within), acc_between = median(acc_between),
           var_tramo = median(deltaEvidence_variance)),
       by = .(i_beta, blk)]

## (a) telescopic ESS per tramo, both directions -----------------------------
es <- melt(b[i_beta > 0, .(blk, tramo = i_beta, up = ess_up, down = ess_dn)],
           id.vars = c("blk", "tramo"), variable.name = "direction", value.name = "ess")
pa <- ggplot(es[is.finite(ess)], aes(blk, ess, group = tramo, colour = tramo)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~direction, ncol = 2) + scale_tramo +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "telescopic ESS",
         subtitle = "samples pooled per window; tramo 15 is the coldest (beta -> 1)") +
    theme_fig

## (b) stretch acceptance, per rung ------------------------------------------
pb <- ggplot(b[is.finite(acc_within)], aes(blk, acc_within, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + scale_rung +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.6)) +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "within-rung stretch acceptance",
         subtitle = "healthy and stationary at every rung") +
    theme_fig

## (c) swap acceptance, per tramo --------------------------------------------
pc <- ggplot(b[i_beta > 0 & is.finite(acc_between)],
             aes(blk, acc_between, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + scale_tramo +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = "between-rung swap acceptance",
         subtitle = "mid tramos degrade all run long; the coldest climbs from zero") +
    theme_fig

## (d) variance of each tramo's contribution to the evidence -----------------
## (dbeta/2)^2 (Var_i logL + Var_{i+1} logL): the trapezoid tramo variance
pd <- ggplot(b[i_beta > 0 & var_tramo > 0], aes(blk, var_tramo, group = i_beta, colour = i_beta)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + scale_tramo +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(x = "iteration", y = expression("Var of tramo contribution (nats"^2*")"),
         subtitle = "the coldest tramo carries the most variance") +
    theme_fig

fig <- pa / (pb | pc) / pd + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
ggsave("Ladder_diagnostics.pdf", fig, width = 7.2, height = 7.6, device = pdf)
fig
```

```{r tail_table}
tl <- d[iter >= 24000,
        .(ess_up = round(median(ess_up)), ess_dn = round(median(ess_dn)),
          swap_between = round(median(acc_between), 3),
          stretch_within = round(median(acc_within), 3),
          var_tramo = signif(median(deltaEvidence_variance), 3)),
        by = i_beta][order(i_beta)]
knitr::kable(tl, caption = "Tail medians (iterations >= 24000). Row k: ESS, swap and variance refer to the tramo (k-1, k); stretch refers to rung k.")
```
